component.name: Vernier
component.summary: Measure and take off quantities from PDF drawings

description.p: Vernier turns a PDF drawing into a measuring tool. Set a real-world scale from one known dimension, then measure lengths with CAD-style snapping that locks the cursor onto the drawing's real vector geometry instead of eyeballed pixels.

ul.li: Render PDF plans with smooth pan and zoom, crisp at any magnification
Set a scale from a known dimension (e.g. 3000 mm)
Measure polyline lengths with vertex and endpoint snapping

screenshot.caption: Measuring on a floor plan, with the scale set and a live readout

description.p: Initial MVP: render a PDF plan, set scale, and measure with snapping.
